Jupiter and Venus are both in the south-east before dawn this week. Jupiter is at its best around 02:40 on Thursday, and Venus, brighter still, is about 24° up at 06:50 the same morning. The new Moon on Wednesday leaves the sky dark for the nights after. Positions computed for central Europe (50°N, 15°E) with astronomy-engine. Narration uses a synthetic voice.
